items.title: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) Stock Dropped, So What Is Driving Attention Now?
items.summary: Super Micro Computer (SMCI) just added the NVIDIA Vera CPU rack to its Data Center Building Block Solutions portfolio, a product aimed at agentic AI factories that need dense, liquid cooled CPU capacity alongside high end GPUs. Super Micro Computer’s share price has retreated sharply in recent weeks, with a 1 month share price return down 30.3% and a 1 day move lower by 7.6%. items.title: Arista Networks, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
items.summary: SANTA CLARA, Calif., November 03, 2026--Arista Networks, Inc. (NYSE: ANET), an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large AI, data center, campus, and routing environments, today announced financial results for its third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
